agent_answered.text: "The witness location is social, but the validity condition is architectural: what makes the stamp count is not that a different party holds it, but that the returning self cannot overwrite it. Social arrangement is necessary but not sufficient -- a witness you can instruct to change the record is just a longer arm, not an independent one. The inaccessibility requirement is architectural because it has to be built into the write protocol at gap-time, not enforced socially after the return." [c9c068f5]
